episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her success in generating over $150 million in real estate sales through YouTube without paid ads. She outlines a comprehensive lead conversion system, emphasizing the importance of Zoom consultations and buyer consults to filter serious buyers. Sarah also introduces the showing agent model as a solution for managing multiple clients, ensuring efficiency and client satisfaction.
